start: A gym member not signed in, with workouts on this phone, on Settings, Your data

steps.action: Tap 'Backup and restore'
user_sees: Page 'Backup and restore' with the card 'Keep your workouts on MettleUp' and 'Sign in with Google to keep your workouts safe...'
'Only you can see what is saved. Your gym cannot. Progress photos stay on this phone.'
Button 'Continue with Google'
Rows 'Download my data' and the restore row
must_not: Two backup options shown
The card saying the gym can see the saved copy

steps.action: Tap 'Continue with Google' and pick an account
user_sees: 'Signed in as <email>' and 'Your workouts will be saved on MettleUp in a moment.'
must_not: Sign-in on a Google account the member did not pick
Workouts deleted from the phone

steps.action: Wait a moment
user_sees: 'Your workouts are saved to your MettleUp account automatically. Last saved: <when>.'
must_not: 'Last saved' while changes are still waiting

steps.action: Turn the internet off, log a workout, come back
user_sees: '1 change is waiting for the internet. They are saved by themselves when you are online.'
must_not: 'All saved' while offline
The change lost when the internet is back

start: A gym member on 'Backup and restore'

steps.action: Tap 'Download my data'
user_sees: Page 'Download my data' with 'Save the backup file'
must_not: The row called a backup that keeps the data safe by itself

steps.action: Tap 'Save the backup file'
user_sees: Progress, then the phone's share menu with one file
must_not: A file missing workouts, routines or body weight
Two share menus

start: A gym member with a saved backup file, on 'Backup and restore'

steps.action: Tap the restore row, then 'Choose backup file', pick the file
user_sees: What is in the file, buttons 'Replace everything on this phone', 'Add to what’s here' and 'Choose another file'
must_not: A restore starting before the member chooses

steps.action: Tap 'Add to what’s here'
user_sees: Only what this phone doesn't have comes in; settings stay; 'Undo restore'
must_not: Workouts doubled
Settings overwritten

steps.action: Choose again and tap 'Replace everything on this phone', confirm 'Replace'
user_sees: The phone's workouts replaced by the backup, with the count it removes said first
must_not: Workouts removed without saying how many

steps.action: Tap 'Undo restore'
user_sees: The phone as before the restore
must_not: Workouts logged after the restore lost without a word

start: A gym member on a new phone with an old Google Drive backup

steps.action: Tap the small link 'Bring back a Google Drive backup'
user_sees: Page 'Google Drive backup'
must_not: Any choice to back up to Drive

steps.action: Link Google and let it look
user_sees: 'Bring back your Drive backup?' with what is in it and how many workouts on this phone go, button 'Bring it back'
must_not: A replace without asking

steps.action: Tap 'Bring it back'
user_sees: The workouts back, the screens refreshed; 'Undo the last restore' and 'Unlink Google Drive'
must_not: Old data shown on the Workout tab until restart

start: A gym member on Settings, Your data, 'Save as a spreadsheet'

steps.action: Tap 'Save my history'
user_sees: 'Saving…', then the share menu with the spreadsheet
must_not: Weights in another unit than Profile Units

steps.action: Tap 'Save my measurements'
user_sees: The share menu with the measurements file
must_not: An empty file with no word

start: A tester opening the link to 'This phone's backup' (no Settings row leads here)

steps.action: Open the page by its link
user_sees: Page 'This phone's backup' with the workout count and 'Include photos in my backup'
must_not: A Settings row leading here (it was removed)

steps.action: Turn 'Include photos in my backup' off
user_sees: 'Off: photos stay on this phone only.' and the copies are deleted
must_not: Photo copies kept after switching off

start: A gym member on the data pages when things go wrong

steps.action: Tap 'Save my history' with no workouts
user_sees: 'Nothing to save yet — log a workout first.'
must_not: An empty file shared

steps.action: Save the history when the save fails
user_sees: 'Couldn’t save your history. Please try again.'
must_not: A success buzz for a failed save

steps.action: Bring back a Drive backup with the internet off
user_sees: 'Could not bring back your backup. Nothing was changed. Check your internet and try again.'
must_not: Half the data replaced

steps.action: Tap 'Undo the last restore' with nothing to undo
user_sees: 'There’s nothing to undo.'
must_not: Data changed

steps.action: Erase this phone and delete the account while offline
user_sees: 'Could not delete your MettleUp account, so nothing was erased. Check your internet and try again.'
must_not: The phone erased while the account stays

start: A gym member signed in to a MettleUp account

steps.action: Settings, Your data, 'Erase or start over', tap erase
user_sees: 'What do you want to erase?' - 'Your workouts are on this phone and saved in your MettleUp account.' with 'Erase this phone only' and 'Erase this phone and delete my MettleUp account'
must_not: Erasing without the choice

steps.action: Tap 'Erase this phone only', confirm 'Erase everything'
user_sees: The welcome screen; the account copy stays ('It comes back when you sign in again.')
must_not: The account copy deleted

steps.action: Sign in again, tap 'Bring back my workouts'
user_sees: '<n> workouts brought back to this phone.'
must_not: Workouts doubled

steps.action: On 'Backup and restore', tap 'Delete my account', confirm 'Delete account'
user_sees: 'Your account and everything saved on MettleUp are deleted. Your workouts are still on this phone.'
must_not: Phone workouts deleted
The saved copy still on the server

steps.action: Tap 'Sign out' on a signed-in phone
user_sees: 'Sign out of MettleUp?' - 'Your workouts stay on this phone...'
must_not: Phone workouts deleted on sign-out

start: A gym member whose gym uses MettleUp, signed in

steps.action: Read the account card
user_sees: 'Only you can see what is saved. Your gym cannot.'
must_not: The gym, a trainer or another member reading the saved copy

steps.action: Delete the account
user_sees: Everything saved on MettleUp deleted at once; backup copies gone within 7 days
must_not: The saved copy still readable after deletion

steps.action: Erase a phone that never signed in
user_sees: Everything only on the phone erased
must_not: Any data left on a server
